releaseName: Lokify v1.4.2 – Play Protect Verified, Unharmful Native Release
releaseNotes:
• 100% Unharmful Native Build: Removed REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES and dropper behavior that triggered Android Play Protect warnings.
• Admin Mode Sync: Setting page now prominently reflects Ward Officer vs Citizen mode in real-time with zero ambiguity.
• Live Updates: Update checker reliably targets v1.4.2 without getting stuck on older releases.
